# Vendored libraries

Bundled locally so the app works offline and in the packaged build. To upgrade one, replace
the file with the new pinned version and update its `<script>` tag in `../index.html`.

| File | Source | License |
|---|---|---|
| `tailwind-3.4.17.js` | https://cdn.tailwindcss.com/3.4.17 (Tailwind CSS Play CDN runtime) | MIT, https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/blob/v3.4.17/LICENSE |
| `chart-4.4.1.umd.min.js` | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.1/dist/chart.umd.min.js | MIT, https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js/blob/v4.4.1/LICENSE.md |
| `lightweight-charts-5.3.0.standalone.production.js` | https://unpkg.com/lightweight-charts@5.3.0/dist/lightweight-charts.standalone.production.js | Apache-2.0, https://github.com/tradingview/lightweight-charts/blob/v5.3.0/LICENSE (TradingView, Inc.) |
